elements.label: Figure 2.10
elements.description:
Stacked bar chart (100% stacked, one bar per income decile). Y-axis: "Share of total household income (%)", scale 0 to 100 in steps of 20. X-axis: deciles 1 to 10, labeled "1 (=poorest decile)" and "10 (= richest decile)". Legend, left to right: Family Farm, Family Business, Wage, SA, Remittances, Pension, Other. Segments are stacked bottom to top in that order. No values are printed on the chart; approximate readings (segment heights, cumulative tops in parentheses) are:
- Decile 1: Family Farm ~34, Family Business ~4, Wage ~52 (top ~90), SA ~3 (~93), Remittances ~4 (~97), Pension ~0, Other ~3.
- Decile 2: Family Farm ~30, Family Business ~10, Wage ~52 (~92), SA ~1, Remittances ~5 (~98), Pension ~1, Other ~1.
- Decile 3: Family Farm ~27, Family Business ~14, Wage ~51 (~92), SA ~0.5, Remittances ~5 (~97), Pension ~1, Other ~2.
- Decile 4: Family Farm ~21, Family Business ~17, Wage ~53 (~91), SA ~0, Remittances ~7 (~98), Pension ~1, Other ~1.
- Decile 5: Family Farm ~20, Family Business ~19, Wage ~52 (~91), Remittances ~5 (~96), Pension ~2, Other ~2.
- Decile 6: Family Farm ~21, Family Business ~23, Wage ~47 (~91), Remittances ~4 (~95), Pension ~2, Other ~3.
- Decile 7: Family Farm ~12, Family Business ~25, Wage ~53 (~90), Remittances ~6 (~96), Pension ~2, Other ~2.
- Decile 8: Family Farm ~9, Family Business ~30, Wage ~51 (~90), Remittances ~4 (~94), Pension ~4, Other ~2.
- Decile 9: Family Farm ~10, Family Business ~27, Wage ~52 (~89), Remittances ~6 (~95), Pension ~1, Other ~3.
- Decile 10: Family Farm ~9, Family Business ~31 (~40), Wage ~43 (~83), Remittances ~4 (~87), Pension ~6 (~93), Other ~7 (~100).
Family Farm share falls steadily from the poorest to the richest deciles, while Wage share stays roughly 40 to 55 across deciles and Family Business share rises with income. Non-labor sources (remittances, pensions, other) are small in most deciles but are largest in decile 10.
